text:
```yaml
name: Java Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'java/**'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up JDK 8
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '8'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Update .gitignore
        run: echo "GSDK_output_*.txt" >> .gitignore

      - name: Build and test
        run: ./gradlew :gameserverSDK:test --info

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          junit_files: '**/build/reports/tests/test/*.xml'
```
